intro: Among Raven Hill's ruins, Jitters lives alone and fears the dangers around him. He survives on help from travelers in western Duskwood, always watching the shadows.

p: Jitters shivers among Raven Hill's ruined houses, afraid of the predators along Duskwood's western trails. He depends on travelers for food and keeps watch for danger. His habit of flinching and leaping clear of sudden threats earned him his name long ago. The fear comes from horrors he has faced himself.
